title: Rate-limit visit creation per owner after the connection-pool incident

actors.name: Clinic staff
actors.description: Records visits through the client application during a consultation.

actors.name: Visits service
actors.description: Owns visit records and the endpoint that creates them.

actors.name: On-call site reliability engineer
actors.description: Carries the availability of the deployed system.

goals.statement: A single misbehaving client must not be able to exhaust the visits service connection pool.
goals.motivation: A client retry loop created visits without backoff and saturated the pool, taking visit creation down for every clinic.

goals.statement: Recording visits at the pace of an ordinary consultation must be unaffected by the protection.

behaviors.statement: Visit creation beyond the configured per-owner rate is rejected with 429 rather than admitted to the pool.
A rejected request carries a Retry-After header stating when the caller may try again.
Visit creation at or below the configured rate succeeds with the response it returned before the change.

acceptance_conditions.statement: The request after the configured per-minute allowance for one owner is answered 429 and creates no visit.

check.description: Integration test driving one owner past the allowance within a minute.

acceptance_conditions.statement: Every 429 from visit creation carries a Retry-After header with a positive whole number of seconds.
Visit creation at the observed clinic peak of twelve requests per minute per owner succeeds with 201 throughout.
The success path of the visit creation operation is unchanged: no removed field, no narrowed type, no new required request property.

check.description: Contract diff of the generated OpenAPI document against the pinned baseline.

exclusions.statement: A clinic-wide or global quota is out of scope; the allowance is per owner.
Changing the client's retry behaviour is out of scope for this change request.

open_questions.question: Should the allowance be the twenty requests per minute proposed in review, or the twelve per minute observed at the busiest clinic?
open_questions.resolution: Twenty per minute: the incident review settled on the observed peak plus headroom, and the value stays configurable. Absorbed into this graph by the transformation plan's IR delta.
